The '''Ambervale''' {{j|琥珀の谷|Kohaku no tani|Amber Valley}} is a location in the world of [[Ivalice]]. A royal palace, it is a safe retreat for members of the royal family.

==Appearances==
=== ''[[Final Fantasy XII]]''===
While never visited, [[Al-Cid Margrace|Al-Cid]] makes mention of the Ambervale of Clan Margrace, located in [[Rozarrian Empire|Rozarria]].

===''[[Final Fantasy Tactics Advance]]''===
[[File:AmbervaleEntry.png|thumb|300px|Marche defeats Llednar in the first part of "Mission #24: Royal Valley".]]
Ambervale is the location of the royal family's summer retreat, and is where [[Remedi|Queen Remedi]] takes [[Mewt Randell]] after [[Marche Radiuju]] tries to find him at the palace. Marche and [[Cid Randell|Judgemaster Cid]] venture here in "Mission #024: Royal Valley" after Cid arms himself with a special [[Law system (Tactics Advance)|Antilaw]].

When Marche and his clan arrive at the entrance to the royal halls, they find [[Babus Swain]] unconscious. [[Llednar Twem]] then enters the scene and attempts to bar the entrance. Cid uses the Antilaw to break the Fortune law that made Llednar invincible, allowing Marche to destroy him. After Llednar's demise, Babus revives, but Cid and Marche do not allow him to enter the Ambervale palace with them.

The two then travel inside, where Remedi confronts them. She casts off her outer robes and draws a huge blade, summoning [[Deph]]s of [[Famfrit (Tactics Advance)|Famfrit]] and [[Adrammelech (Tactics Advance)|Adrammelech]] to aid her. When Marche manages to defeat her, she shows her true form, the Li-Grim, and calls to her two Dephs of [[Mateus (Tactics Advance)|Mateus]] and launches a second assault on Marche. Once again, Marche prevails, causing the world to revert to normal.

====After clearing the game====
A large amount of non-numbered side-missions are available after the main game is cleared, including some that allow [[Clan Nutsy]] to recruit secret characters. Babus is recruited in "Mission: With Babus", which takes place in Ambervale. Mewt's old stuffed bear turns out to hold a ghostly copy of Queen Remedi's Li-Grim form in "Mission: Memories". After the mission is completed, the ''Stuffed Bear'' mission item is obtained, which turns out to be a present from Mewt's deceased real mother. Ambervale can be freed in "Mission #262: Ambervale".

====Encounter: Doned Faction====
{{Quote|Faction of the newly established "Clan Doned". On a fast rise to ascendance.|Description}}
*Time Mage (Moogle)
*Dragoon (Bangaa)
*Sniper (Viera)
*Fighter (Human)
*Sage (Nu Mou)
